title: Ordinary question and statement ends with no pauses, backchannels or barge-ins

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Thanks for calling the support line. What can I help you with?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Hi, I'd like to know what time you open on Saturdays.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: On Saturdays we open at nine in the morning and close at one in the afternoon.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Great, that works for me. Can I book a Saturday slot now?

items.speaker: agent
items.text: You can. This Saturday has openings at nine, ten and eleven. Which would you like?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Ten o'clock, please. I'll have my son with me.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Ten o'clock on Saturday is booked, and your son is welcome. Will you need parking?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Yes, I'll be driving. Is there a car park nearby?

items.speaker: agent
items.text: There is a car park directly behind the building, and the first hour is free. Anything else I can help with?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: That's all I needed. Thanks very much, bye.
